about: Production list for Dead Internet graphics. Ids are stable and used by the world (content/universe/images.json). Replace a file by saving it under the same name; no code changes. Order matters: generate originals before the copies derived from them.

style.photo: Realistic smartphone photo, natural light, slight noise, no text overlays, no real brands.
style.profile: Square avatar, realistic, as a person would choose for themselves. Synthetic personas: subtly too smooth, with one visible AI tell.
style.ui: Fictional interface, original design, no resemblance to real products.

characters.mara: Woman, 34, warm round face, freckles, short dark curly hair, small silver hoop earrings, green parka. Use one fixed face reference for every image of Mara.
characters.theo: Man, 29, Mara's brother: same freckles and dark curly hair, cut short. Tired eyes, grey hoodie. Use one face reference.
characters.dana: Woman, 41, reporter: reading glasses pushed up, ink on one finger, cardigan. Use one face reference.
characters.owen: Man, 63, former mill worker: weathered face, flat cap, thick glasses. Only seen in his own photos (low quality).
characters.iris: Woman, 26, writer: never shows her whole face. Coffee cups, window light, hands.
